busy: This agent is busy: it is working, waiting for an answer or has background work. Archive it once it is done.
close_busy: This agent is busy (working, waiting, a loop, queued messages or a server), so it can't be closed now. Archive it without closing, or wait until it is done.
upgrade: Update the hub's assistant to archive agents.
close_upgrade: Update the hub's assistant to archive and close agents.
archived_not_running: Archived “{title}”. It wasn't running, so there was nothing to close
archived_still_open: Archived “{title}”, but it's still open on its computer: {reason}
archived_close_unknown: Archived “{title}”. The hub didn't say whether it closed
